name: Devine Impex Limited
about: Devine Impex Limited trades in bullion, gems, jewellery, gold, and diamonds in India. The company offers diamond pendants and gold rings; and trades in stocks/shares. The company was formerly known as Classic Global Impex Ltd. and changed its name to Devine Impex Limited in March 2007. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mohali, India.
